{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for any non-numeric characters or formatting issues
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Strip commas and convert to float
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (999999.99) — but no such rows found
print("QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", data[data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = data[data['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = completed_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Output the results
print(channel_revenue)"}
